d.title: Wu Liuqi: Xuanwu Guo Pian
d.synopsis: In order to protect the residents of Xiaoji Island and the peaceful life here, Wu Liuqi and his partners Dabao and Xiaofei embark on a journey to the Xuanwu Kingdom to find out the truth about his identity and a way to save the island. Waiting for them is more unknowns and adventures.

rel.name: Wu Liuqi: Zui Qiang Fa Xing Shi
